name: Morgan
source:
A black-haired woman of unknown occupation who Aruji met in town. She's reserved and lacking in expression, giving off a somewhat dark impression. Willing to do anything for money, she's likely in the same line of business as Aruji, belonging to some organization or guild.

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/character04.php]official website[/url]]
